dispute.claim_text: Wah lau this driver take me all the way to Jurong Point for what?? My trip is Clementi to Bukit Batok only, 6km thing become 14km, 34 minutes for a 15 minute trip. He anyhow drive to increase the fare. $21.32 for such a short trip is not reasonable at all. Refund the extra, this kind of driver should be banned lah.

counterparty_statement.text: She asked me in the chat to stop at Jurong Point first to buy something, I said ok and waited six minutes at the PHV pickup point for her. Now she says I anyhow drive. The app also did not charge her for the full distance, I drove 13.8 km and the receipt shows 9.6 km.

admissibility.notes: Trip record complete. No endpoint amendment: this is POL-RD-04 territory, not POL-RD-05.

pickup.label: Clementi MRT, PHV Pickup Bay, 3155 Commonwealth Ave West

dropoff.label: Bukit Batok MRT, PHV Pickup Bay, 10 Bukit Batok Central

admissibility.notes: Unbroken 10 s telemetry, 100% coverage. Puts the vehicle stationary 38 m from the Jurong Point PHV pickup point recorded as the waypoint_hint on MSG-00109-001, for 366 s, which is the corroboration POL-RD-04 requires.
Four messages. MSG-00109-001 is the rider's own request to stop at Jurong Point, sent one minute after the meter started.

admissibility.notes: Line items reconcile to the cent. distance_charged_km of 9.60 is below both trace_distance_km and actual_distance_km: the driver was under-billed, which is a substantive POL-RD-04 finding and NOT a cross-source conflict. DISTANCE_MISMATCH compares the trace against actual_distance_km, 13.76 against 13.80, and does not fire.

issue_details.detail: No advisory applies. The detour is explained by the rider's own instruction, not by any road condition.
